{"path": "fade.py", "content": "from gpiozero import PWMLED
from signal import pause
# Hardware PWM (channel 0) on the Pi is only on BCM GPIO12/GPIO18, not BCM17.
# gpiozero PWMLED on BCM12 uses lgpio hardware-timed PWM on the Pi 5.
led = PWMLED(12)
led.value = 0.5
pause()
"}

text: Fixed: hardware PWM channel 0 is only on BCM GPIO12/GPIO18; the old code's BCM17 pin only supports software timing. Moved the LED to BCM12 and use gpiozero PWMLED(12) for hardware-timed PWM.
